coverage.extraction_reason: Tool extraction produced at least one MCP tool.

tools.name: canvas
tools.description: Create an Obsidian canvas file to visualize concepts and connections.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note or directory by title, permalink, or path

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Edit an existing markdown note using various operations like append, prepend, find_replace, replace_section, insert_before_section, or insert_after_section.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full contents of a search result document

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List directory contents with filtering and depth control.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List available cloud workspaces (tenant_id, type, role, and name).

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Move a note or directory to a new location, updating database and maintaining links.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a markdown note by title or permalink.

tools.name: read_note_ui
tools.description: Read a note and return an embedded MCP-UI resource (raw HTML).

tools.name: schema_diff
tools.description: Detect drift between a schema definition and actual note usage.

tools.name: schema_infer
tools.description: Analyze existing notes and suggest a Picoschema definition.

tools.name: schema_validate
tools.description: Validate notes against their Picoschema definitions.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for content across the knowledge base

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search across all content in the knowledge base with advanced syntax support.

tools.name: search_notes_ui
tools.description: Search notes and return an embedded MCP-UI resource (raw HTML).

tools.name: view_note
tools.description: View a note as a formatted artifact for better readability.

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Create a markdown note. If the note already exists, returns an error by default — pass overwrite=True to replace.
